name: Saelienne
summary: Innkeeper Saelienne manages the inn situated on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She provides weary travelers and local artisans with food, drink, and a peaceful hearthstone retreat in the heart of the night elven capital.

sections.title: Hospitality on the Terrace
sections.body: Situated amidst the bustling workshops and trade stalls of the Craftsmen's Terrace, Innkeeper Saelienne offers a calm respite for both residents and visitors to Darnassus. As a keeper of the hearth, she caters to adventurers arriving from across Kalimdor and beyond, serving staple night elven refreshments alongside goods brought into the city port. Her establishment serves as a primary gathering place for tradesfolk seeking rest after long hours at the forge or loom.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Saelienne?
faq.answer: Saelienne is located on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus, running the local inn tucked among the trade trainers and crafting shops.
She acts as an innkeeper, allowing players to bind their Hearthstone to Darnassus. She also sells various food and drink items suitable for restoring health and mana.

faq.q: Does Saelienne offer any seasonal tasks?
faq.answer: During the Hallow's End festivities, Saelienne participates in holiday celebrations, offering Alliance adventurers the quest Dancing for Marzipan in exchange for holiday treats.

angles.text: For night elf adventurers returning from the wild reaches of Teldrassil, Saelienne's inn offers a familiar hearth among the artisans of Darnassus.
Alliance envoys and tradesfolk traveling to the remote canopy of Teldrassil rely on Saelienne for food, drink, and a warm hearthstone sanctuary.
